content_sections.heading: About IIM Ranchi Research Assistant (RA)
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Ranchi is a management institute in Ranchi. This recruitment is for one Research Assistant (RA) who will support the concerned faculty of the Operations Management Area. The work covers coding, data analysis and research support, together with academic and administration needs of the faculty and the Institute. The notice describes the post as contractual.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be major in Industrial Engineering & Management/ Operations Management/Operations Research/Mathematics and computing or allied areas. Candidates applying for the full-time position must have completed graduation. Candidates who are in the third or fourth year of graduation, or who are pursuing post-graduation, may apply for the part-time position. A good academic record with exposure to mathematical modelling, algorithms and coding. Knowledge of MATLAB, CPLEX, MATHEMATICA or other optimization related software, and generative AI. The age limit is "Preferably below 35 Years". The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A full-time candidate will be fulltime stationed at IIM Ranchi. For a full-time candidate, the total remuneration is not to exceed Rs. 30000 p.m. A part-time candidate will work from his or her own location and travel to IIM Ranchi as and when required. The allowance of up-to Rs. 5000 per visit will be reimbursed when the candidate travels to Ranchi for project related work. Any or both sides can terminate the contract with a written notice of one month. Upon selection, the candidate is expected to report for work on 01/12/26.

rows.additional_allowance: Up to Rs. 5000 per month for outstation candidate

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one position (01) of Research Assistant (RA) in the Operations Management Area of IIM Ranchi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date of emailing the CV is 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be major in Industrial Engineering & Management, Operations Management, Operations Research, Mathematics and computing or allied areas. A completed graduation is required for the full-time post.

faq.question: Q4. Can students apply for the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates in the third or fourth year of graduation, or pursuing post-graduation, may apply for the part-time position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The notice states the age as "Preferably below 35 Years".

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The full-time remuneration is Rs. 20000-25000 per month, plus up to Rs. 5000 per month for an outstation candidate, with the total not exceeding Rs. 30000 p.m. The part-time remuneration is Rs. 15000-20000 p.m., plus up-to Rs. 5000 per visit to Ranchi.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email your CV to [email protected] by 17 November 2026, with the CV file named as your full name.

faq.question: Q8. What subject should the application email have?
faq.answer: The subject must be "Application for Research Associate Position in Operations Management".

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will attend a Personal Interview at IIM Ranchi around the last week of November, and the details will be communicated to them.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IIM Ranchi Research Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is contractual: 3 months for full-time and 3-4 months for part-time. Either side can terminate the contract with a written notice of one month.
